pr_title: config: add tcp4only for lvs whitelist!
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #21551

Problem Summary:
make "lvs_test"@"allow_ip" can work in lvs.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:
tidb/server/server.go: add "tcp4" mode
tidb/config/config.go: add "enable-tcp4-only" option

How it Works:
After loading module `toa` in RealServer of lvs, "tcp4" protocal can Read the tcp header and parse the real client IP.

Reference: https://www.jianshu.com/p/e770a11481e9

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`:
- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

All Tests Above passed.

Side effects

Nothing!

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->
- Add enable-tcp4-only config for whitelist client ip through lvs.
